newsitem.title: UK: Yule Catto says buys Aroma Chemicals.
newsitem.headline: Yule Catto says buys Aroma Chemicals.

text.p: UK speciality chemicals and building products firm Yule Catto & Co said on Monday it had acquired the business of Dutch firm PFW Aroma Chemicals BV for a consideration of $35.0 million (21.5 million stg) payable in cash.
The consideration excludes associated costs, the company said in a statement.
PFW, a leading manufacturer of polycyclic musk, would operate as an autonomous unit within Yule Catto, the statement added.
PFW has an estimated asset base of 10.8 million stg and generated profits of 3.0 million stg in 1995 on a turnover of 20.4 million stg.

Commenting on the acquisition, Yule Catto's chief executive Alex Walker said: "It provides a close fit with our existing activities in the manufacture of speciality chemicals for the flavour and fragrance industry and creates ample opportunity for future growth".
